Dhammānulomapaccanīya (3), Tikapaṭṭhānapāḷi (1) 13.10.
Ācayagāmittika (The Triplet on Leading to Accumulation)
Conditioned by a state leading to accumulation (*ācayagāmi*), a state not leading to accumulation arises by way of the root-condition (*hetupaccaya*).

Conditioned by a state leading to accumulation, a state not leading to dispersal (*apacayagāmi*) arises by way of the root-condition. Conditioned by a state leading to accumulation, a state that leads neither to accumulation nor to dispersal...

A state arises by way of root-condition. Dependent on a state leading to accumulation, states that do not lead to accumulation and states that lead neither to accumulation nor to dispersal arise by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a state leading to accumulation, states that do not lead to accumulation and states that lead neither to accumulation nor to dispersal arise by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a state leading to diminution, a state not leading to diminution arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state leading to diminution, a state not leading to accumulation arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state leading to diminution, a state that leads neither to accumulation nor to diminution arises by way of root condition. Dependent on a state leading to diminution...
